generationInputs.prompt:
A single 9:16 vertical storyboard sheet containing 6 numbered panels arranged in 1 column x 6 rows.

STYLE:
Vox-style editorial paper collage documentary animation. Hand-cut paper cutouts with visible torn and scissor-cut edges, layered over a warm cream textured paper background with visible newsprint fibre, subtle halftone dot pattern and light scanned-print grain. Archival photographic cutouts rendered in grayscale or two-tone duotone, printed on paper with a slight registration offset, some held down with short strips of masking tape. Soft realistic drop shadows under every cut layer so the paper thickness reads clearly.

Restrained editorial palette: warm cream and off-white base, deep ink navy, charcoal black, muted brick red, and ONE saturated accent — highlighter yellow — used sparingly and only for emphasis.

Hand-drawn annotation marks in felt-tip pen: circles, arrows, underlines, dotted guide lines, quick highlighter sweeps.

Deliberately handmade and slightly imperfect — edges not perfectly aligned, textures not perfectly clean. Editorial, not advertising. Clean composition, generous negative space.

TYPOGRAPHY:
On-screen typography, Vox editorial house style: heavy condensed sans-serif, all caps, tight letter-spacing, thick uniform strokes. The text sits directly on the paper collage as if letterpress-printed or cut from a newspaper headline — slight ink texture, faint registration offset.
Colour: ink navy or charcoal printed on the cream paper. 
Maximum four words on screen at any time. Exactly one text element per shot.

GRID LAYOUT:
Arranged in 1 column x 6 rows. Each panel features a small index mark in the upper left corner: a small blue ink circle containing the panel number (1 to 6).

Panel 1:
Text: "AMENAZA VEGETAL SILENCIOSA"
Visual: Bamboo stalk cutout next to a paper steel beam crossed out with brick-red tape on textured cream paper.

Panel 2:
Text: "RED SUBTERRANEA IMPATABLE"
Visual: Felt-tip arrow diagram on paper showing underground root networks spreading beneath a cracked cardboard road.

Panel 3:
Text: "DIA MUNDIAL DOS MIL NUEVE"
Visual: Giant paper cutout number "2009" in deep ink navy landing over a world map cutout.

Panel 4:
Text: "ABSORCION CARBONO CUATRO X"
Visual: Hand-drawn bar chart on paper comparing carbon absorption levels, with a yellow highlighter sweep emphasizing the highest bar.

Panel 5:
Text: "REEMPLAZO INDUSTRIAL MASIVO"
Visual: Monochrome archival photo cutout of an industrial factory overlaid with paper cutouts of bamboo sprouts.

Panel 6:
Text: "DIECIOCHO DE SEPTIEMBRE"
Visual: Unfolding paper map with major bamboo regions highlighted in bright yellow ink and felt-tip guide lines.
